title: UB Hunter
description:
> [!info] Part of this project happens outside Xenon
> Xenon covers a good part of this: Debug and Release builds (the status bar switches between them) stand in for `-O0` and `-O2`, and **Memory checks** in the editor's More menu is AddressSanitizer. UBSan, TSan, MSan and the CMake set-up need clang or g++ on your own machine. Keep each bug in its own Playground project so each one builds alone.
requirements: A collection of 25 small programs, each demonstrating a different UB/lifetime bug from [[13.01 Undefined Behavior and Object Lifetime]]
For each: the bug, behaviour at `-O0` vs `-O2`, which tool detects it (ASan/UBSan/TSan/MSan/clang-tidy/constexpr), and the fix
A CMake option to build all of them with each sanitizer; a script that summarises which were caught *(on your own machine)*
A `REPORT.md` table — your personal UB encyclopedia
